{"metadata":{"description":"Threadline（脉络）—— 通过交互式关系图与时间轴，直观呈现工作区文件之间的关联及其修改历史 | Threadline for DSH — Visualize workspace file relationships and modification history through interactive graphs and timelines.","id":"gh:1408841705","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-control-your-development","slug":"HaoyanZhang123/dsh-plugin-control-your-development","topics":["ai-agents","awesome-dsh-plugin","awesome-dsh-plugins","chinese","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-market","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugin-marketplace","dsh-plugins","dshx-hub","force-directed-graph","graph-visualization","observability","open-plugin-market","read-only","session-analysis","visualization","workspace"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Threadline（脉络）—— 通过交互式关系图与时间轴，直观呈现工作区文件之间的关联及其修改历史 | Threadline for DSH — Visualize workspace file r"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"elationships and modification history through interactive graphs and timelines."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"Threadline / 脉络
A read-only DSH plugin that turns what a conversation did to your workspace into a d"},{"id":"p2s2","text":"rillable timeline.
中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Threadline is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that answers a
narrow question well: **what did th"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"is conversation actually change in my workspace?**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It collects the files a turn touched, the commands it ran, the subagents it spawned and the relation"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"s
between turns, then presents them as one drillable timeline embedded in the DSH session view. Ever"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ything
is **read-only**: the plugin never writes to your workspace, never stores anything, never ope"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ns an extra
entry point."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It is built for people who let an agent work in a repository and then need to review the result — no"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"t for
planning, task assignment or code editing."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Relation graph of the current directory.** A deterministic force-directed layout where folders a"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"re
rounded cards and files are dots. Edges are layered (skeleton, top-3 co-occurrence, the rest on h"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"over),
capped at `1.6 ×` node count so the graph never turns into a spider web.
- **Folder-to-folder"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" links.** Aggregated from real cross-directory relations only. Folders with no real
relation go to a"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" perimeter ring and are never connected by a fabricated edge.
- **Node cap with an honest switch.** "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"Up to 40 files by default; a persistent `Show N/M` chip switches to
the full set in place and auto-d"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"egrades density, labels and radius. Hard ceiling 300.
- **Dual-track timeline.** An activity histogr"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"am per time bucket on the upper track, one row per session on
the lower track, a single playhead lab"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"el, and exactly three scale ticks.
- **Turn strip with lock-first selection.** Click a turn to lock "},{"id":"p8s10","text":"it, hover another turn without losing the
lock, click again to release. Double-click the timeline to"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" snap back to "now".
- **Workspace file browser.** Starts at the workspace root, navigates to any de"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"pth, breadcrumb / back /
refresh, card or list view, virtualization beyond 200 rows.
- **Zero third-"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"party runtime dependencies.** `dependencies` is an empty object; React and `@deepseek-ai/*`
are peer"},{"id":"p8s14","text":" dependencies provided by the host."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Threadline is a DSH plugin. Install it through the DSH plugin manager, or with npm:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Requirements:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- DSH with runtime `0.2.1-rc.5` or later (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session >= 0.2.0-0`)
- React 18 and Reac"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"t DOM 18 provided by the host (not bundled)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Restart DSH after installing or replacing the package. Replacing an already-loaded plugin requires a"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"
process restart; a page refresh alone does not reload it."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Three surfaces, no fourth entry point:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Surface | Where | What you get |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| **Threadline tab** | `conversation.view`, id `threadline` | Left column: relation graph of the cur"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"rent directory + dual-track timeline + turn strip. Right column: workspace file browser. Both column"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"s scroll independently. |
| **Impact count** | assistant message actions, id `threadline-impact` | F"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"iles / commands / subagents touched by that turn. Clicking jumps to the Threadline tab focused on th"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"at turn — no dialog. |
| **`/threadline`** | input box command (also `/脉络`) | Jumps to the Threadlin"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"e tab for the current session. |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Typical flow:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. Open a session and switch to the **Threadline** tab.
2. The left graph shows the current director"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"y. Click a folder card to enter it; the right column follows.
3. Hover a file to highlight its relat"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ions; click to pin the evidence panel.
4. Click a turn in the strip to lock that turn's file graph. "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"Click it again to release.
5. Drag a folder card or a file dot to rearrange. Use `Fit` to reset the "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"camera and `Reset` to clear drags."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Folder-to-folder links"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"A directory with many subfolders is not a scatter of isolated cards: folders that really exchanged
f"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"iles are connected, so you can see which parts of the workspace move together."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### One turn in isolation"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Clicking a turn switches the left graph to that turn's files and overlays the read / write line coun"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"cking a turn switches the left graph to that turn's files and overlays the read / write line counts."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Node cap"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Directories with more than 40 files keep the most active ones and show a persistent `Show N/M` chip."},{"id":"p26s2","text":"
Switching to the full set degrades density, labels and radius automatically."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"> The screenshots above are rendered from the real component with a synthetic fixture dataset, so th"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"e
> file names are test data; the interface itself is not a mock-up."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"No configuration is required. The plugin reads the session's working directory from DSH and needs no"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"
environment variables, tokens or storage paths."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Project structure"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Releases"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Current release: **panel plugin v1.4.1** (stable)."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- Changelog: CHANGELOG.md
- GitHub Releases: https://github.com/HaoyanZhang123/dsh-plugin-control-yo"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"ur-development/releases"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"MIT — see LICENSE."}],"truncated":false}
